BrochureContent.Content:
Dixon Residential Estate Agents, The Dublin Property Experts, are delighted to present 142 Mount Garrett Park to the Tyrrelstown property market.

This well-presented two-bedroom home offers bright and spacious accommodation throughout, making it an ideal choice for first-time buyers, downsizers or investors alike.

Upon entering, you are welcomed by a generous entrance hall, which provides access to the principal rooms. The well-appointed kitchen/dining area is connected to the spacious living room, creating a bright and sociable open-plan living space. The kitchen/dining area is practical and well laid out, with a useful pantry providing additional storage, while the generously proportioned living room benefits from excellent natural light. The accommodation is completed by two well-proportioned bedrooms and a family bathroom.

The property offers approximately 60 sq. m. (654 sq. ft.) of gross internal accommodation and provides a well-balanced layout with excellent potential to suit a variety of buyers.

The location is second to none, with Tyrrelstown Village just minutes away, providing a wide range of shops, cafés, schools, and local amenities. The property enjoys excellent connectivity, with Dublin Airport approximately 20 minutes away and easy access to Clonee, Dunboyne, Clonsilla, Blanchardstown Village, and Blanchardstown Shopping Centre. Nearby employment hubs include the corporate parks of Dublin 15 and Connolly Hospital. Phoenix Park and Castleknock Village are also within a short drive.

The property benefits from an excellent selection of both primary and secondary schools in the surrounding area. Regular public transport links provide easy access to Dublin City Centre, while the nearby M50 and M3 motorways ensure convenient commuting throughout Dublin and beyond.

Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate everything this excellent home has to offer.
